Title: Torturing Jev
Description:
In 1865, the economist Mr. William Stanley Jevons made some sort of
statement. What he said is irrelevant for our purposes. What is
relevant, however, is the fact that he died in 1882. Recent developments
in computing have allowed computer scientists to revive him in the form
of Jev AI. TypeSafe, the makers of Jev, have provided an API to allow us
to ask Jev questions. The timing couldn’t be better, since for
Halloween, I’ve decided to torture Jev.

Title: Experimenting with Bindless Textures in WebGPU
Description: When WebGPU first shipped back in 2023, one of the biggest gaps that it had relative to its native counterparts was that it didn’t support bindless resources. Happily, WebGPU is on the cusp of supporting bindless texture sampling, with other resource types coming after that! You can try it out today in your own pages, and see a live example of it in action at emojigraffiti.com.
